profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazon
profile.summary:
Hi! I'm Ryan Lee and I graduated from the University of California, Berkeley back in Summer 2018. I double majored in Computer Science and Cognitive Science.

I currently work as a software engineer over at Amazon on the CloudWatch Anomaly Detection team.

Reach out to me if you would like more information about my interests or just to discuss anything else in general!

Contact: ryanllee@berkeley.edu

positions.title: Software Development Engineering Intern (amazon.com/live)
positions.description:
•	Enhanced customer engagement with retail site through creation of React widgets
•	Simplified workflow for team and saved developer hours by building framework to generalize widget placements in lightbox components
•	Boosted traction and user adoption of product by querying into database for product star ratings/reviews and rendering them on team owned retail page

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern (cbs.com)
positions.description:
• Utilized Spring MVC to design and develop a multi-tier web service as a full stack developer 
• Serialized and deserialized XML/JSON to and from POJOs for data access/storage in Redis database
• Created system to facilitate buying of keywords in videos and injecting ads when they are said

positions.title: Development Assistant
positions.description:
•	Developed mail listings to obtain donations to go towards museum events
•	Performed data entry jobs on Excel and FileMaker Pro to update membership information and donor spreadsheets
•	Completed various jobs utilizing the functions of the Xerox machine, ranging from tasks such as Photocopying to custom printing

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Equipped a class of Kindergarten, 1st, and 2nd graders with the academic knowledge to succeed in core subjects taught in schools
•	Created lesson plans to ensure that students keep up with the course work taught in the upcoming academic year 
•	Effectively communicated basic math and English practices to ensure academic success

• Directed groups of students to designated areas to relieve overcrowding
• Monitored the check in table to ensure that the arrival of attendants went smoothly
• Provided support on various other tasks to ensure all events were executed on time and provide all attendees with an overall great experience at the largest hackathon to date

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description:
Created at InterHacks 2015, day-long workshops focused on portfolio website development.

Ongoing project as I continue to explore web development. I will continue to add on as I learn more about Ruby on Rails, Javascript, and PHP.
